title: US Officials Warn of Increase in Bacterial Illnesses That Could Be Deadly (1/2)
titleZh: 美國官方警告：可能致命的細菌感染增加（1/2）
summaryZh: 美國疾管中心警告侵襲性腦膜炎雙球菌感染增加，並說明症狀。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Health & Lifestyle

sentences.text: United States health officials are warning of an increase in rare bacterial illnesses that can lead to meningitis.
sentences.zh: 美國衛生官員警告，一種可能引發腦膜炎的罕見細菌感染正在增加。

sentences.text: It is a serious and often deadly disease in which an outside barrier of the brain or related tissues becomes infected and swollen.
sentences.zh: 腦膜炎是一種嚴重、而且常常致命的疾病，患者的腦部外層或相關組織會受到感染並腫脹。

sentences.text: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, CDC,
sentences.zh: 美國疾病管制與預防中心，也就是 CDC，

sentences.text: issued a warning on March 28th about the increase in one kind of invasive meningococcal disease called serogroup Y. Last year,
sentences.zh: 在三月二十八日發出警告，指出一種名為 Y 血清群的侵襲性腦膜炎雙球菌疾病病例增加。去年，

sentences.text: 422 cases of it were reported in the U.S., the most in a year since 2014. So far this year,
sentences.zh: 美國通報了四百二十二例，是二〇一四年以來單年最多的一次。今年到目前為止，
已經通報一百四十三例。

sentences.text: That means infections are on their way to go above 2023 numbers, the CDC said.
sentences.zh: CDC 表示，這代表感染人數有可能超過二〇二三年的數字。

sentences.text: Most of the cases last year did not involve meningitis, though at least 17 died.
sentences.zh: 去年大部分的病例並沒有引發腦膜炎，不過至少有十七人死亡。

sentences.text: The cases were more common in adults ages 30 to 60, in black people, and those who have HIV, the CDC said.
sentences.zh: CDC 說，這些病例比較常出現在三十到六十歲的成年人、黑人族群，以及帶有愛滋病毒的人身上。

sentences.text: HIV is a virus that can lead to AIDS, a serious disease that can destroy the body's natural defense system.
sentences.zh: 愛滋病毒可能導致愛滋病，那是一種會破壞人體自然防禦系統的嚴重疾病。

sentences.text: The infection caused by meningococcal disease can lead to symptoms that may include high body temperature, head and upper body pain, nausea, and throwing up.
sentences.zh: 腦膜炎雙球菌造成的感染可能出現的症狀包括發高燒、頭部和上半身疼痛、噁心和嘔吐。

sentences.text: The bacteria can also cause an infection in the blood system.
sentences.zh: 這種細菌也可能造成血液系統的感染。

sentences.text: That infection could bring cold, tiredness, cold hands and feet, quick breathing, diarrhea, or discoloration of the skin.
sentences.zh: 這種感染可能帶來發冷、疲倦、手腳冰冷、呼吸急促、腹瀉，或是皮膚變色。

sentences.text: The infection can be treated with medications like antibiotics.
sentences.zh: 這種感染可以用抗生素之類的藥物治療。

sentences.text: But treatment must beậtous, but treatment must be quick to be successful.
sentences.zh: 但治療必須……但治療必須夠快，才會有效。
